        const ease = {

            exponentialOut: (t) => { return t == 1.0 ? t : 1.0 - Math.pow(2.0, -10.0 * t); },

                    : t < 0.5
                    ? +0.5 * Math.pow(2.0, (20.0 * t) - 10.0)

            circularInOut: (t) => {
                return t < 0.5
                    ? 0.5 * (1.0 - Math.sqrt(1.0 - 4.0 * t * t))

                str += (this.isOpened) ? `V 0 H 0` : `V 100 H 0`;

            constructor(elm) {

                this.duration = 900;
                this.delayPointsArray = [];

            exponentialOut: (t) => {

                return t < 0.5

        class ShapeOverlays {
            constructor(elm) {

                this.numPoints = 4;
                this.duration = 800;
                this.delayPointsArray = [];
                this.delayPointsMax = 180;
                this.delayPerPath = 70;
                this.timeStart = Date.now();
                this.isOpened = false;
                this.isAnimating = false;
            }
            toggle() {
                this.isAnimating = true;
                const range = 4 * Math.random() + 6;
                for (var i = 0; i < this.numPoints; i++) {
                    const radian = i / (this.numPoints - 1) * Math.PI;
                    this.delayPointsArray[i] = (Math.sin(-radian) + Math.sin(-radian * range) + 2) / 4 * this.delayPointsMax;

                if (this.isOpened === false) {
                    this.open();
                } else {
                    this.close();
                }
            }
            open() {
                this.isOpened = true;
                this.elm.classList.add('is-opened');
                this.timeStart = Date.now();

            close() {
                this.isOpened = false;
                this.elm.classList.remove('is-opened');
                this.timeStart = Date.now();
                this.renderLoop();
            }
            updatePath(time) {
                const points = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < this.numPoints + 1; i++) {
                    points[i] = ease.cubicInOut(Math.min(Math.max(time - this.delayPointsArray[i], 0) / this.duration, 1)) * 100
                }

                let str = '';
                str += (this.isOpened) ? `M 0 0 V ${points[0]} ` : `M 0 ${points[0]} `;

        /* ==================== js/easings.js ==================== */
        const ease = {
            cubicInOut: (t) => {
                return t < 0.5
                ? 4.0 * t * t * t
                : 0.5 * Math.pow(2.0 * t - 2.0, 3.0) + 1.0;

        /* ==================== js/demo2.js ==================== */
        class ShapeOverlays {
            constructor(elm) {
                this.elm = elm;
                this.path = elm.querySelectorAll('path');
                // Configurações específicas para o efeito visual da Demo 2
                this.numPoints = 10;
                this.duration = 900;
                this.delayPointsArray = [];
                this.delayPointsMax = 300;
                this.delayPerPath = 60;
                this.timeStart = Date.now();
                this.isOpened = false;
                this.isAnimating = false;
            }
            toggle() {
                this.isAnimating = true;
                
                // Demo 2: Atraso linear para criar uma onda direcional suave
                for (var i = 0; i < this.numPoints; i++) {
                    this.delayPointsArray[i] = (i / (this.numPoints - 1)) * this.delayPointsMax;
                }
                
                if (this.isOpened === false) {
                    this.open();
                } else {
                    this.close();
                }
            }
            open() {
                this.isOpened = true;
                this.elm.classList.add('is-opened');
                this.timeStart = Date.now();
                this.renderLoop();
            }
            close() {
                this.isOpened = false;
                this.elm.classList.remove('is-opened');
                this.timeStart = Date.now();
                this.renderLoop();
            }
            updatePath(time) {
                const points = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < this.numPoints + 1; i++) {
                    points[i] = ease.cubicInOut(Math.min(Math.max(time - this.delayPointsArray[i], 0) / this.duration, 1)) * 100
                }

                let str = '';
                str += (this.isOpened) ? `M 0 0 V ${points[0]} ` : `M 0 ${points[0]} `;
                for (var i = 0; i < this.numPoints - 1; i++) {
                    const p = (i + 1) / (this.numPoints - 1) * 100;
                    const cp = p - (1 / (this.numPoints - 1) * 100) / 2;
                    str += `C ${cp} ${points[i]} ${cp} ${points[i + 1]} ${p} ${points[i + 1]} `;
                }
                str += (this.isOpened) ? `V 0 H 0` : `V 100 H 0`;
                return str;
            }
            render() {
                if (this.isOpened) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < this.path.length; i++) {
                        this.path[i].setAttribute('d', this.updatePath(Date.now() - (this.timeStart + this.delayPerPath * i)));
                    }
                } else {
                    for (var i = 0; i < this.path.length; i++) {
                        this.path[i].setAttribute('d', this.updatePath(Date.now() - (this.timeStart + this.delayPerPath * (this.path.length - i - 1))));

                }
            }
            renderLoop() {
                this.render();
                if (Date.now() - this.timeStart < this.duration + this.delayPerPath * (this.path.length - 1) + this.delayPointsMax) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                        this.renderLoop();
                    });
                }
                else {
                    this.isAnimating = false;

                    + i.y + vec4(0., i1.y, i2.y, 1.))

                bgGeometry.setAttribute(
                    'position',
                    new THREE.BufferAttribute(
                        new Float32Array([-1, -1, 0, 3, -1, 0, -1, 3, 0]),
                        3
                    )
                );
                bgGeometry.setAttribute(
                    'uv',
                    new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array([0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 2]), 2)
                );

                // Material final que exibe o resultado
                bgMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
                    vertexShader: `
                        varying vec2 vUv;
                        void main() {
                            vUv = uv;
                            gl_Position = vec4(position, 1.0);
                        }
                    `,
                    fragmentShader: `
                        uniform sampler2D uTrailMap;
                        varying vec2 vUv;
                        void main() {
                            vec3 color = texture2D(uTrailMap, vUv).rgb;
                            gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
                        }
                    `,
                    uniforms: {
                        uTrailMap: new THREE.Uniform(),
                    },
                    depthWrite: false,
                });
                bgMesh = new THREE.Mesh(bgGeometry, bgMaterial);
                scene.add(bgMesh);

                // Render Targets
                const createRenderTarget = () => {
                    const rtWidth = Math.max(sizes.width * config.resolutionScale, 64);
                    const rtHeight = Math.max(sizes.height * config.resolutionScale, 64);
                    return new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(rtWidth, rtHeight, {
                        type: THREE.HalfFloatType,
                        minFilter: THREE.LinearFilter,
                        magFilter: THREE.LinearFilter,
                        depthBuffer: false,
                    });
                };

                rt1 = createRenderTarget();
                rt2 = createRenderTarget();

                inputRT = rt1;
                outputRT = rt2;

                // Shader de Feedback
                trailMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
                    vertexShader: trailVertex,
                    fragmentShader: trailFragment,
                    uniforms: {
                        uResolution: new THREE.Uniform(new THREE.Vector2()),
                        uMap: new THREE.Uniform(),
                        uPointer: new THREE.Uniform(new THREE.Vector2(0, 0)),
                        uDt: new THREE.Uniform(0.0),
                        uSpeed: new THREE.Uniform(0),
                        uTime: new THREE.Uniform(0),
                        uColor1: new THREE.Uniform(new THREE.Color(config.color1)),
                        uColor2: new THREE.Uniform(new THREE.Color(config.color2)),
                        uColor3: new THREE.Uniform(new THREE.Color(config.color3)),
                        uDissipation: new THREE.Uniform(config.dissipation),
                        uNoiseScale: new THREE.Uniform(config.noiseScale),
                        uNoiseSpeed: new THREE.Uniform(config.noiseSpeed),
                        uSpeedMultiplier: new THREE.Uniform(config.speedMultiplier),
                        uMinRadius: new THREE.Uniform(config.minRadius),
                        uMaxRadius: new THREE.Uniform(config.maxRadius)
                    },
                });
                trailMesh = new THREE.Mesh(bgGeometry, trailMaterial);
                sceneTrail = new THREE.Scene();
                sceneTrail.add(trailMesh);

            } catch (e) {
                console.warn("Falha ao instanciar WebGL Renderer. Ativando fallback 2D.", e);
                useFallback = true;
            }
        }

        // --- SISTEMA DE LOGICA & SIMULAÇÃO 2D (FALLBACK) ---
        // Ativo caso WebGL seja bloqueado ou indisponível
        
        const particles = [];
        const maxParticles = 200;

        function getWaveVelocity2D(x, y, t) {
            // Simulação de turbulência fluida usando ondas sinusoidais complexas
            const scale = 0.003 * config.noiseScale;
            const angle = Math.sin(x * scale + t * config.noiseSpeed) * Math.cos(y * scale + t * config.noiseSpeed) * Math.PI * 4;
            return new THREE.Vector2(Math.cos(angle) * 1.5, Math.sin(angle) * 1.5);
        }

        class FluidParticle {
            constructor(x, y, vx, vy) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.vx = vx * 0.4 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
                this.vy = vy * 0.4 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
                this.life = 1.0;
                this.decay = 0.008 * config.dissipation + Math.random() * 0.01;
                this.size = (config.minRadius * sizes.width) * (0.8 + Math.random() * 1.2);
                
                // Distribuição de cores do rastro baseado nas cores configuradas
                const r = Math.random();
                if (r < 0.4) {
                    this.color = config.color2; // Ciano
                } else if (r < 0.8) {
                    this.color = config.color1; // Roxo/Azul
                } else {
                    this.color = config.color3; // Branco brilhante
                }
            }

            update(dt, t) {
                const force = getWaveVelocity2D(this.x, this.y, t);
                this.vx += force.x * 0.15;
                this.vy += force.y * 0.15;
                
                this.vx *= 0.95;
                this.vy *= 0.95;

                this.x += this.vx;
                this.y += this.vy;
                this.life -= this.decay;
            }

            draw(ctx) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = this.life;
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
                
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, 0, this.x, this.y, this.size);
                grad.addColorStop(0, this.color);
                grad.addColorStop(0.3, this.color);
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
                
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
            }
        }

        // --- CAPTURA DE MOVIMENTOS ---

        function updatePointerCoords(x, y) {
            rawPointer.x = x;
            rawPointer.y = y;
            pointer.x = (x / sizes.width) * 2 - 1;
            pointer.y = -(y / sizes.height) * 2 + 1;
        }

        window.addEventListener('pointermove', (ev) => {
            updatePointerCoords(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
        });

        window.addEventListener('touchstart', (ev) => {
            if (ev.touches.length > 0) {
                updatePointerCoords(ev.touches[0].clientX, ev.touches[0].clientY);
                if (!useFallback) {
                    trailMaterial.uniforms.uPointer.value.copy(pointer);
                }
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        window.addEventListener('touchmove', (ev) => {
            if (ev.touches.length > 0) {
                updatePointerCoords(ev.touches[0].clientX, ev.touches[0].clientY);
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        // --- LOOPS DE ATUALIZAÇÃO ---

        const clock = new THREE.Clock();
        let lastPointerX = null;
        let lastPointerY = null;

        // Loop de Renderização WebGL Original
        function tic() {
            const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.1);
            time += dt;

            trailMaterial.uniforms.uTime.value = time;
            const prevPointer = trailMaterial.uniforms.uPointer.value;

            const pointerDiff = Math.sqrt(
                (pointer.x - prevPointer.x) ** 2 + (pointer.y - prevPointer.y) ** 2
            );
            trailMaterial.uniforms.uSpeed.value = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
                trailMaterial.uniforms.uSpeed.value,
                pointerDiff,
                dt * 4.5
            );

            trailMaterial.uniforms.uPointer.value.lerp(pointer, dt * 15);
            trailMaterial.uniforms.uDt.value = dt;

            trailMaterial.uniforms.uMap.value = inputRT.texture;
            renderer.setRenderTarget(outputRT);
            renderer.render(sceneTrail, camera);

            renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
            bgMaterial.uniforms.uTrailMap.value = outputRT.texture;
            renderer.render(scene, camera);

            const temp = inputRT;
            inputRT = outputRT;
            outputRT = temp;

            requestAnimationFrame(tic);
        }

        // Loop de Renderização 2D Fallback
        function tic2D() {
            const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.1);
            time += dt;

            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            
            // Fundo persistente com leve transparência criando efeito de rastro
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 5, 8, 0.15)'; 
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, sizes.width, sizes.height);

            // Emite partículas à medida que o cursor se move
            if (rawPointer.x !== null && rawPointer.y !== null) {
                if (lastPointerX !== null && lastPointerY !== null) {
                    const dx = rawPointer.x - lastPointerX;
                    const dy = rawPointer.y - lastPointerY;
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                    
                    const steps = Math.min(Math.floor(dist / 4), 6) || 1;
                    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
                        const alpha = i / steps;
                        const px = lastPointerX + dx * alpha;
                        const py = lastPointerY + dy * alpha;
                        if (particles.length < maxParticles) {
                            particles.push(new FluidParticle(px, py, dx * config.speedMultiplier, dy * config.speedMultiplier));
                        }
                    }
                }
                lastPointerX = rawPointer.x;
                lastPointerY = rawPointer.y;
            }

            // Atualiza e desenha partículas
            for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const p = particles[i];
                p.update(dt, time);
                if (p.life <= 0) {
                    particles.splice(i, 1);
                } else {
                    p.draw(ctx);
                }
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(tic2D);
        }

        // --- SISTEMA DE REDIMENSIONAMENTO ---

        function handleResize() {
            sizes.width = window.innerWidth;
            sizes.height = window.innerHeight;

            if (useFallback) {
                canvas.width = sizes.width;
                canvas.height = sizes.height;
                return;
            }

            const rtScale = config.resolutionScale;
            trailMaterial.uniforms.uResolution.value.set(
                sizes.width * rtScale,
                sizes.height * rtScale
            );

            renderer.setSize(sizes.width, sizes.height);
            
            rt1.dispose();
            rt2.dispose();
            rt1 = createRenderTarget();
            rt2 = createRenderTarget();

            inputRT = rt1;
            outputRT = rt2;

            const pixelRatio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2);
            renderer.setPixelRatio(pixelRatio);
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

        // --- LIMPEZA DE TELA INICIAL ---

        function clearBuffers() {
            if (useFallback) return;
            const currentRT = renderer.getRenderTarget();
            renderer.setRenderTarget(rt1);
            renderer.clear();
            renderer.setRenderTarget(rt2);
            renderer.clear();
            renderer.setRenderTarget(currentRT);
        }

        // --- INICIALIZAÇÃO ---

        window.onload = function() {
            handleResize();
            if (useFallback) {
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.fillStyle = '#050508';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, sizes.width, sizes.height);
                tic2D();
            } else {
                clearBuffers();
                tic();
            }
        };

    </script>
</body>
</html>
